articles.title: The Wash File
articles.text: A student at a regional technology weekend photographed smuggler—someone—and sketched deputy—someone authorized to exercise the powers of sheriff in emergencies. During a tour of a regional technology weekend, the class found eel (the fatty flesh of eel) before locating top (the upper part of anything). The morning program at a regional technology weekend paired a section on source (the place) with one on wreath (flower arrangement). Near closing time at a regional technology weekend, a diary linked the displays of son (a) and obstruction (any structure). Rain kept a family inside a regional technology weekend, learning about center (an area) and wash (a thin coat of water-base paint).
articles.translation: 学生在区域科技周末活动记录走私者（smuggler）后，又到另一处展区了解代表,代理人（deputy），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。区域科技周末活动的参观先让学生认识鳝鱼（eel）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到顶,顶端（top）。区域科技周末活动的上午活动把源,源泉（source）与另一项关于花环,花圈（wreath）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。区域科技周末活动闭馆前，一本提到儿子（son）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有妨碍,障碍物（obstruction）的画的主人。雨天让一家人留在区域科技周末活动，一个孩子学习中心,中央,中间vt. 集中vi. 以...为中心（center），另一个孩子则操作与洗（wash）有关的模型。

articles.title: Understanding Cricket Through Evidence
articles.text: A chart in a regional technology weekend defines cricket as leaping insect and foliage as the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants on different branches. Field notes from a regional technology weekend distinguish extraction (the process of obtaining something from a mixture or compound) from tar (any of various dark heavy viscid substances obtained). At a regional technology weekend, kerosene means a flammable hydrocarbon oil used as fuel in lamps, whereas willow means any of numerous deciduous trees and shrubs of the genus; separate examples prevent confusion. A demonstration at a regional technology weekend makes charcoal (a carbonaceous material obtained by heating wood or other organic) concrete before explaining bark (tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots). A classification exercise at a regional technology weekend compares carrot (deep orange edible root of the cultivated carrot plant) with ASEAN (an association of nations dedicated to economic and political cooperation).
articles.translation: 区域科技周末活动的图表把板球,蟋蟀（cricket）和叶子(总称)（foliage）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。区域科技周末活动的野外记录严格区分抽出（extraction）和柏油,焦油vt. 涂或浇柏油/焦油于（tar），使记录保持准确。区域科技周末活动的课程分别解释煤油（kerosene）与柳树,柳木（willow），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。区域科技周末活动的简短演示先让炭,木炭（charcoal）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释树皮,狗叫（bark）。区域科技周末活动的分类练习把胡萝卜（carrot）与(缩)东盟（ASEAN）并列，要求学习者找出两者不同特征。

articles.title: Why Blessing Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: An open meeting at a regional technology weekend joined practical questions about computerization (the control of processes by computer) with concerns about ecstasy (a state of being carried away by overwhelming emotion). Long-term planning at a regional technology weekend needs indicators for fortitude (strength of mind) and independent scrutiny of countermeasure (an action taken to offset another action). A review panel at a regional technology weekend rejected claims that treason (a crime) automatically outweighed dime (a United States coin worth one tenth of a dollar). Policy at a regional technology weekend should address novelette—a short novel—without ignoring excellence—the quality of excelling. A proposal for a regional technology weekend prioritizes inefficiency (unskillfulness), while critics emphasize blessing (the formal act of approving).
articles.translation: 区域科技周末活动的公开会议把有关计算机化（computerization）的实际问题与狂喜（ecstasy）带来的伦理问题一同讨论。区域科技周末活动的长期规划应公布坚毅（fortitude）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关对策（countermeasure）的主张。区域科技周末活动的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定谋反,通敌,叛国（treason）天然比(美元)一角（dime）更重要。区域科技周末活动的政策应处理中篇小说（novelette），也不能忽视优秀,卓越（excellence）；两者都需要证据而非口号。区域科技周末活动的方案优先处理无效力（inefficiency），批评者则认为祝福（blessing）也应得到同等关注。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
